title: Affine perfect support extension
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let T be a closed subset of X whose complement is quasi-compact, and let U be a quasi-compact open of X. For every perfect object F of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] whose cohomology sheaves vanish on U\setminus(T\cap U), there exists a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_X) whose cohomology sheaves vanish on X\setminus T and such that E|_U is isomorphic to F\oplus F[1].

proof.text: Since X is affine, write T=V(g_1,...,g_s) for finitely many global functions. The complement of T is quasi-compact, so such a finite principal-open description exists; replacing each g_i by a suitable power does not change T.

Apply the affine perfect extension lemma [lem-sc-affine-perfect-plus-shift] to F on U. We obtain a perfect E on X with E|_U isomorphic to F\oplus F[1]. Since F is supported on T\cap U, multiplication by each g_i is zero on F after replacing g_i by a power, by [lem-sc-perfect-into-support-on-T] applied on U.

Form successive cones of multiplication by g_i on E. The iterated-cone statement [lem-sc-affine-support-iterated-cones] gives a perfect complex C_s supported on T; on U its restriction is a finite direct sum of shifts of F, with multiplicity \binom{s+1}{j} in degree j.

Use [lem-sc-affine-perfect-map-lift] with A=C_s, E'=C_s, and the endomorphism which is zero on the unique degree-0 F summand and the identity on all other shifted summands of C_s|_U. It supplies a perfect C' supported on T, a map beta:C'\to C_s that is an isomorphism on U, and a compatible map gamma:C'\to C_s. The quoted last clause gives that C' is supported on T. Since C_s is supported on T as well, Cone(gamma) is supported on T by the elementary two-of-three property for cohomology sheaves. The cone is perfect; on U the cone cancels the unwanted summands and is isomorphic to F\oplus F[1]. Set E=Cone(gamma).
